Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I'll keep it between us. I won't mention Bluefin or the Albany site in any channel or to anyone else, and that includes Ruth.

I haven't checked or confirmed any of it. I only have what Mateo told you. Do you want me to do something with it? I could help you draft a note for Ruth, or find a time on her calendar for a briefing. Any mail to Ruth would stay internal, since she's at pemberline.com.
